description: A proposal to publish a brief (title, markdown, optional language) to the board. On confirmation the server's live score gate decides whether it publishes; publishing emails a one-time link and signs no one in. The whole proposal is limited to 64,000 UTF-8 bytes. Stores a proposal only. Nothing happens until the person confirms it on welance.com/directory; the result includes the review link.

summary.description: One sentence, in the conversation language, saying what happens on confirm.
